results.text: Tribal Patrol: Roll on Table 4.1 (Tribal Patrol and Motivation).
Sandstorm: Visibility 0; 80% chance party veers off course; movement 1/4 unless halted.
Earthquake: Dexterity check or fall prone. 4-in-6 chance of fissure nearby; 1-in-6 right beneath PCs.
Acidic Rain: Lasts [[/r 2d4]] rounds; deals [[/r 1d4]] dmg/round per character level to exposed flesh (metal/cloth unaffected).
Forbidden Zone Scarecrow: 8-ft tall effigy of scrap metal, wood, and bones built by ([[/r 1d6]]): 1. Goblins, 2. Orcs, 3. Bugbears, 4. Gnolls, 5. Lizardmen, 6. Unknown.
Omen ([[/r 1d6]]): 1–3: Heads on Pikes (decapitated human/demi-human heads); 4–6: Pillar of Smoke 1 hex away in a random direction.
Temperature Change ([[/r 1d6]]): 1–3: Extreme Scorching Heat (as Heat Metal); 4–6: Freezing Rain/Snowstorm (as Freeze Metal). Lasts 10 hours; half movement.
Sinkhole: Constitution check to avoid sliding down; +1 cumulative penalty per round. Natural 20 sucks PC under immediately.
Insect Plague ([[/r 1d6]]): 1–3 Locusts, 4–6 Beetles. Dig in, cover up, or huddle with torches, or be scattered into a random adjacent hex.
